item.title: Eni divests 10% stake in Côte d’Ivoire’s Baleine oilfield to SOCAR
item.description: Italian energy company Eni has completed the sale of a 10% interest in the Baleine offshore oil project in Côte d’Ivoire to the State Oil Company of Azerbaijan Republic (SOCAR).
